trigger: P0581's hard contrast cap 20 lost one exact held-out root, while post-open hard caps 5 and 10 restored all 11 roots with little change in common-system RMS.
question: Is exact-root stability controlled mainly by the maximum endpoint contrast, by the nondifferentiable hard clipping rule, or by both?

hypotheses.amplitude: If maximum contrast is the driver, all bounded modes should gain roots as the asymptote is reduced.
hypotheses.kink: If the hard clipping kink is the driver, smooth modes should retain more roots than hard clipping at the same nominal ceiling.
hypotheses.null: If neither pattern repeats across clusters, the P0581 lower-cap result is cluster-specific caustic luck.

locked_field.source_positions: P0581 fitted source positions held fixed
locked_field.field_policy: ordinary baryonic field local; only zero-monopole angular distribution of the P0554 excess changes

contrast_grid.normalization: After transformation, divide by the carrier-weighted annular mean so every annulus retains exactly zero added monopole.

selection.rule: First maximize complete systems, then total converged roots, then minimize equal-system RMS across complete systems.
selection.predictive_use: No winner may be called predictive on these four clusters; any chosen form must be frozen for a new raw cluster.

claim_limits: All four clusters were opened in P0581, so this is formula exploration rather than validation.
Lens geometry and source positions are fixed at the P0581 cap-20 fit; no saturation variant is refitted.
The zero-monopole angular correction tests image placement and topology, not absolute missing cluster strength.
The Solar and axisymmetric galaxy response is null by construction and therefore does not constitute a new galaxy rotation fit.
